ignored.jurassicraft:gametest_*: Registered only by the Forge GameTest source set; never in the production JAR.

jurassicraft:*_fossil_*.why: Fossil bones come from cleaning encased fossils and from loot or trades; worth a bone, which keeps grinding (bone meal, flint or soft tissue) from gaining.

jurassicraft:*_fresh_*.why: Fresh bones drop from dinosaurs; a bone each, the same as the soft tissue they always grind into.

jurassicraft:*_encased_fossil.why: Cleaning yields exactly one fossil bone of the species, so an encased fossil is worth one bone.

jurassicraft:*_soft_tissue.why: Ground from fossil or fresh bones and fossilized eggs; never worth more than the bone it came from.

jurassicraft:fossilized_egg*.why: Ground into soft tissue, bone meal or flint; a bone so grinding never gains.

jurassicraft:*_log_petrified.why: Petrified tree worldgen; above bone meal (48) so grinding into bone meal, flint or plant tissue never gains.

plant fossils.why: Dropped by plant fossil blocks; ground into bone meal, flint or plant tissue, so worth one bone meal.

jurassicraft:*_plant_tissue.why: Ground from petrified logs and plant or twig fossils; no more than the bone meal those grind into.

amber.why: Rare ore drops (about one per ore, Fortune-boosted) and the only source of dinosaur and plant DNA.

jurassicraft:sea_lamprey.why: A fish found in ice shards; valued like cod.

jurassicraft:dna_nucleotides.why: Smelted from a water bottle (an NBT ingredient the tool cannot parse); ProjectE values water bottles at 1.

jurassicraft:gypsum_powder.why: Gypsum stone drops up to 24 powder with Fortune and 9 powder craft back into stone, so powder is renewable like cobblestone.

jurassicraft:*_meat.why: Raw dinosaur meat from carcasses; valued like beef.

fish food.why: Caught one in twenty uses of a fine net, which wears out; a quarter of a cod.

jurassicraft:mealworm_beetles.why: The bug crate breeds 2 mealworms from wheat (24) and 6 from bread (72); 8 keeps every food worth more than its offspring.

small plants.why: Prehistoric plants and corals grown from callus or found in the world; valued like a small flower.

jurassicraft:west_indian_lilac.why: Tall flowering bush; valued like a lilac.

berries.why: Bush harvests; valued like sweet berries.

seeds.why: Crop seeds; valued like wheat seeds.

jurassicraft:ajuginucula_smithii_leaves.why: Crop harvest (2–5 per plant); valued like wheat.

jurassicraft:wild_onion.why: Self-seeding root crop; valued like a carrot.

jurassicraft:wild_potato.why: Root crop; valued like a potato.

jurassicraft:phoenix_fruit.why: Dropped by phoenix leaves; valued like an apple.

jurassicraft:moss.why: Spreads over peat; worth a moss block, which keeps the 5-moss mossy cobblestone and stone brick recipes above vanilla.

jurassicraft:peat.why: Swamp soil that spreads; valued like dirt.

trackways.why: Decorative worldgen stone that always drops itself; valued like stone.

loot books.why: Structure-loot souvenirs with no recipe; valued like a book.

conversions.name: plant_cells
conversions.why: An empty syringe used on a bush turns into plant cells.

conversions.name: dna_synthesizer
conversions.why: The DNA synthesizer fills a test tube with nucleotides and keeps the dinosaur or plant DNA disc.

conversions.name: embryonic_syringe
conversions.why: The embryonic machine combines dinosaur DNA, a petri dish and an empty syringe.

conversions.name: embryonic_callus
conversions.why: The embryonic machine combines plant DNA, plant cells in a petri dish and an empty syringe.

conversions.name: calcification
conversions.why: The embryo calcification machine turns a syringe and a chicken egg into a dinosaur egg.

exclude.jurassicraft:*_fossil_block: Ore-like worldgen that drops nothing when mined; like ProjectE's ores, only what it yields has EMC.
exclude.jurassicraft:plant_fossil_block: Ore-like worldgen; mined or cleaned it yields plant fossils, coal, flint or cobblestone, which carry the value.
exclude.jurassicraft:amber_ore: Ore; Fortune multiplies its amber, so it gets no EMC, like vanilla ores in ProjectE.
exclude.jurassicraft:ice_shard: Ore-like worldgen that drops sea lampreys with Fortune; only the drops have EMC.
exclude.jurassicraft:nest_fossil*: Ore-like worldgen; once encased and cleaned a nest yields up to seven fossilized eggs.
exclude.jurassicraft:encased_nest_fossil*: Cleaning yields one to seven fossilized eggs at random, so no single value is safe.
exclude.jurassicraft:*_hatched_egg: Places a living dinosaur even without NBT; transmuted copies would act as spawn eggs.
exclude.jurassicraft:coelacanth_gestated: Releases a living coelacanth even without NBT; transmuted copies would act as spawn eggs.
exclude.jurassicraft:*_spawn_egg: Creative spawn eggs; ProjectE gives spawn eggs no EMC.
exclude.jurassicraft:cockroaches: The bug crate breeds 16 cockroaches from a pumpkin, which Item Alchemy values at 9, so any whole-number value would create EMC.
exclude.jurassicraft:crickets: The bug crate breeds 7 crickets from a leaf block and 2 from grass (1 EMC each), so any whole-number value would create EMC.
exclude.jurassicraft:dinosaur_meat: Creative-only generic meat; no survival source.
exclude.jurassicraft:dinosaur_steak: Only cooked from the creative-only generic meat.
exclude.jurassicraft:birthing_wand: Creative tool that forces births (living-entity duplication).
exclude.jurassicraft:breeding_wand: Creative tool that forces breeding (living-entity duplication).
exclude.jurassicraft:tracker: Creative-only item with no recipe or use.
exclude.jurassicraft:lunch_box: Creative-only souvenir with no recipe or loot.

music discs.why: Creative-only music discs with no recipe or loot (and not in minecraft:music_discs).

exclude.jurassicraft:skeleton_display: Built in the skeleton assembly table; the species lives in NBT, so one value cannot match its parts.
exclude.jurassicraft:ancient_item_holding_block: Structure decoration from the creative tab; no survival recipe.
exclude.jurassicraft:dart_tipped_potion: The potion lives in NBT and the custom recipe is invisible to ProjectE; transmuted copies would have no effect.

processes.name: grind_fossil_bone
processes.why: Fossil grinder: a fossil bone becomes bone meal, flint or its species' soft tissue.

processes.name: grind_fresh_bone
processes.why: Fossil grinder: a fresh bone always becomes its species' soft tissue.

processes.name: grind_petrified_log
processes.why: Fossil grinder: a petrified log becomes bone meal, flint or its tree's plant tissue.

processes.name: grind_plant_fossil
processes.why: Fossil grinder: a plant or twig fossil becomes bone meal, flint or a random plant tissue.

processes.name: grind_fossilized_egg
processes.why: Fossil grinder: a fossilized egg becomes bone meal, flint or a random species' soft tissue.

processes.name: clean_encased_fossil
processes.why: Cleaning station: an encased fossil becomes one random bone of its species.

processes.name: growth_serum
processes.why: Using growth serum returns the empty syringe.

processes.name: eat_phoenix_fruit
processes.why: Eating phoenix fruit sometimes returns phoenix seeds.

processes.name: bug_crate_mealworms_1
processes.why: Bug crate: wheat seeds or melon seeds breeds 1 mealworm; the parent is kept.

processes.name: bug_crate_mealworms_2
processes.why: Bug crate: wheat or pumpkin seeds breeds 2 mealworms; the parent is kept.

processes.name: bug_crate_mealworms_3
processes.why: Bug crate: potato breeds 3 mealworms; the parent is kept.

processes.name: bug_crate_mealworms_4
processes.why: Bug crate: carrot breeds 4 mealworms; the parent is kept.

processes.name: bug_crate_mealworms_6
processes.why: Bug crate: bread breeds 6 mealworms; the parent is kept.

processes.name: bug_crate_mealworms_16
processes.why: Bug crate: hay block breeds 16 mealworms; the parent is kept.
